abuse_prevention: Bearer token required for the write endpoint; read endpoints carry no PII.
Idempotency keys prevent retry storms from creating duplicate leads.
Email MX verification blocks fake addresses.
The only side effect is a lead email — nothing destructive, no payments.

auth.note: Merchant-style connector: the caller is the homeowner via Muse, so there is no per-user OAuth. Meta stores one scoped connector token and sends it as Authorization: Bearer. Endpoints fail closed (503) until the token is configured.

connector.description: Request a tree-service quote from Onslow Tree Removal (Jacksonville / Onslow County, NC) — tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, lot clearing, and emergency storm cleanup.
connector.name: Onslow Tree Removal

data_handling.collected: name, phone, email, street address, service details, optional tree photo.
data_handling.photos: Uploaded to a temporary image host and auto-deleted after 72 hours. Documented in the privacy policy.
data_handling.storage: No database. Lead details exist only in the email sent to the business inbox (newriverdigitalnc@gmail.com).
data_handling.validation: Email domains are MX-verified before a lead is accepted; phone numbers must be valid 10-digit US numbers.

limits.idempotency: Duplicate idempotency_key values return the original response for 24h (best-effort, per serverless instance); the key is also stamped on the lead email so duplicates are visible to the business.
limits.rate_limit: 20 quote requests per hour per connector token (best-effort, per serverless instance).

review_testing.note: Meta reviewers can exercise the full write path safely with dry_run: true (validates everything, hosts the photo, sends nothing) plus any idempotency_key. A review bearer token is provided in the submission form.

tools.description: List the tree services offered, with contact info. No auth required.
tools.name: get_services

tools.description: Check which towns in Onslow County NC are covered. No auth required.
tools.name: get_service_area

tools.description: Submit a tree-service quote request (a sales lead) on the homeowner’s behalf. Requires the connector bearer token. idempotency_key is required so retries never create duplicate leads. Supports dry_run for testing.
tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.side_effects: Sends one lead email to the business inbox. No charges, no bookings, no account changes.

user_story: A homeowner in Jacksonville, NC tells Muse: “a pine fell on my fence last night, I need someone to look at it.” Muse checks the service area, confirms emergency storm cleanup is offered, collects the homeowner’s name, phone, email, and address, and submits a quote request. The business calls back.
